notes.title: BasementVR is becoming Postity now
notes.content:
Hi all VR enthusiasts- 
soon we'll stop supporting BasementVR to focus our full effort on Postity.

All of you who don't have it yet in your wish list I highly encourage to add it here:
store.steampowered.com/app/646400

And join our newsletter on this website, to get early access to Alpha: www.postity.com

notes.title: 1.3 - I'm better, I'm better!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27084283/11bf3aaf3bbeb3b2c56927fa4b01e047c3c14803.gif[/img]

[h1]Today BasementVR just became more social. [/h1]

We were thinking a lot about how do you use the app and came out with this idea. Thanks for the feedback and Steam recommendations! 

[b]We present to you: The Common Hall.[/b]

It is a special place where everybody can hang out and create using our tools. Everything you do will disappear after one hour.
What’s more: you will be able to see top rooms, recent rooms you entered and our selected rooms.

Don’t wait and jump in to BasementVR to create some more awesome stuff and check if it was your room that was featured!

notes.title: 1.2 - You room is safe now !
notes.content:
We've just [b] locked your room[/b], now others can only see it, not destroy it.
Also it's now way easier to move between rooms- just point them with teleport and release the touchpad.~

See you there !

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hI8GxzOhPbo7S/source.gif[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Featured most popular rooms in the city
notes.content:
Hi guys !
Thank you for your support in our development - we're really glad that you actively helping us with bug tracking, and coming up with ideas how to improve our product.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1][list][*]Most popular rooms are now much higher so they're easier to spot.
    [*]Onboarding system is working much smoother right now
    [*]You can login with your email address - soon you will receive your online address to your room to share it with friends more easily.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27084283/16637adcc2c325a928b707c2015929531e94ac72.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Important for everyone of you having onboarding issues !
notes.content:
Hello VR enthusiasts !
You're wonderful audience, we're happy that we've reached 80 users in the first day since our Early Acces launch. Thank you all for your time !

However we saw that some of you was having issues with completing on boarding tutorial.

We're working on that - and tomorrow we'll release patch which will help you along the way.

Thank you for your creativity, and stay tuned for lot's of great features we'll be adding soon.

Ps.
If you have any troubles in-app, please write them down here, we'll make sure that all of them will be addresses.

Thank you !

notes.title: BasementVR preview
notes.content:
Hello, we have brand new video for you showing what we're going to release the first version of our app.

Once you've downloaded it, you will be able to see other users, visit each others rooms, and use wide range of tools ( i.e. Giphy search engine).

We can't wait to show you more, and release our app.

It's only 13 days to release !

Stay tuned :)

Link to video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjPyMMx7zEU&t=9s
